<div class="card-body">
'''Vader's Obsession''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ベイダーの執念</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の移動フェイズに、ベイダーが隣接位置からルークのいる位置へ移動した時に使う。二人の間で決闘を行う。双方ともに、運命数を２回引いて、戦闘力に加える。勝者は点数の差の分だけ、失ったフォースを回復させることができる。敗者は同数のフォースを失い、戦闘を行ったキャラクターをロストデッキへ送る。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Vaders-Obsession-SWCA-97585.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ベイダーはすべてのジェダイを狩り出し、抹殺しようとした。最後の一人、オビ＝ワンを倒した彼は、若きスカイウォーカーに目を転じた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Vader's Obsession.

'''Card text:''' Use during your move phase when Vader moves from an adjacent site to Luke's site. The two fight a duel. Each player draws two destiny and adds them to power. The winner may recover lost Force equal to the difference. The loser loses the same amount of Force and sends the character who fought to the Lost Pile.

'''Lore:''' Vader hunted down every Jedi to wipe them out. Having struck down the last, Obi-Wan, he turned his eyes to young Skywalker.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Vader's Obsession]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
